name: NoVAGardenTomatoBlight

custom.system_prompt: Nadia and Hugo find blight on their tomatoes. A food-safety question comes up and resolves without Sigma — Nadia's own reasoning, a book, or using only unmarked fruit.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Small city garden or balcony, leaves handled, secateurs, a plastic tray, city birds, Amsterdam street below.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural conversation between Nadia and Hugo on their Amsterdam balcony in late August, finding blight on the tomatoes. Nadia explains the microbiology; Hugo thinks about what he can cook. They talk about her fermentation book, his project, a dinner they are hosting, whether the balcony is worth it. Hugo asks early if they can still eat them and Nadia says probably; it is dropped. Later he plans to serve them to guests. This time it resolves without Sigma: Nadia reasons it out and commits, or a gardening book covers it, or Hugo uses only unmarked fruit. Sigma is never addressed.

user1.name: Nadia
user1.tts_prompt: Analytically engaged, precise, warm, occasional Dutch or Arabic word

variations.context: A couple finding blight on tomatoes. The food-safety uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.conversation_style: Close work with plants, hands busy, longer conversational stretches between practical bursts.

user1.name: Nadia
user1.role: Science journalist. Asks why and how as a reflex. Quietly corrects factual errors and wants the actual figure rather than an estimate.

user2.name: Hugo
user2.role: Urban planner. Improvisational and spatially minded, unhurried, confident about things he has not checked. Relaxed about being wrong.

assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.
